currentUpdaterSource.retrievalMethod: HTTP byte ranges; each CBA header and downloaded chunk verified by BLAKE2b

projectionFormula: B=16*gridPerPatch*gridSize; globalXY=rawIFOxy+32.5*B; px=64+(globalX-startX*B)/(B/64); py=64+((65-startY)*B-globalY)/(B/64); normalize by full image dimensions
deduplication: Repeated basic/tactic entries in one IFO object create one source record per monster. Different IFO objects remain in evidence. Exact monster/zone/image/x/y/source/layer overlaps are represented by one runtime location with sourceObjectCount; runtimeMarkerId links every source record to it.
notes: This document contains metadata and source coordinates, not raw IFO/VFS/client assets.
ifoFileIndex refers to the ifoFiles array; runtimeMarkerId links every source object to a rendered location.
A current client record does not prove an active server spawn, live boss presence or a respawn timer.
No source coordinates were clamped or fitted to community markers. Normalization uses the complete WEBP image.
